designSummary: Descriptive synthesis in two strands with a side-by-side joint display; no pooling.
sampleSize: Not a sample: every eligible report is included. From the library's preliminary counts, about 1,400 titles are expected; at about 1.5 minutes per title, single screening takes about 35 hours and duplicate screening of the whole set about 70 hours, which fits only because the resident joins in January. About 90 full texts are expected (60 for strand A, 30 for strand B).
primaryAnalysis: Strand A: evidence map and tables of use measures, denominators and reported change by setting and delivery mode. Strand B: framework synthesis coding reasons for acceptance or refusal to three committee themes plus inductive codes, summarised by professional group and setting.
secondaryAnalysis: Strand A: acceptance by delivery mode and caseload; clinical outcomes with concurrent interventions; staffing. Joint display: strand A and strand B findings for surgery, intensive care and small hospitals shown next to each other without transforming either.
missingData: Items not reported are charted as not reported; authors are not contacted within the timeline.
software: Reference manager for screening; spreadsheet charting form for strand A; a coding matrix for strand B.
overfittingGuards: No pooled effect across use measures
Strand B coded without reference to strand A results until the joint display
Charting forms fixed after testing on nine records
summary: Two descriptive syntheses and a joint display; screening sized to the staff available.
